calls.video_title: Should You Buy Pinterest Stock Before the Huge Investor Update?
calls.price_at_call: trading over $22 (stated; was $15 at the year's low, down 14% YTD); forward P/E 9.3 (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated - he owns it, keeps it in his top 10 stocks to buy in 2026 and reiterated that top-10 rating today ahead of the 29 Oct earnings / investor update. Not a flip: last tracked Parkevtate PINS call was BUY (5 Oct ranking).
calls.base_case: Fundamentals improving at a near-all-time-low valuation: one of the few social platforms still adding North American users (highest ARPU), users skew young so ARPU should rise as they age; analysts expect EPS growth over 27% a year vs a 9.3x forward P/E; operating margin 6.3% and improving even after stock comp.
calls.bull_case: Buy-before-earnings framing: risk-neutral buyers should put 75% of the intended allocation in before the print and 25% after; risk-averse buyers 50/50. Meta's results (revenue +26%, ad market better than a year ago) are a positive read-across for Pinterest's 29 Oct print.
calls.bear_case: R&D is 29%+ of revenue - higher than Meta, Snap and Reddit - with little product innovation to show for it; revenue per employee is down from the ~$900k 2022 peak. Stock has badly lagged in 2026 (down 14% vs S&P 500 up over 10%).

calls.thesis: DCF fair value $35; user growth in lucrative North America; owns it.
